title: Database Migration for Understanding, Context & Specification

extends_for_context.note: Context column addition is part of schema-context feature (c005)

summary.goal: Update database schema and storage layer to persist understanding (plan-level) and specification (step-level, stored within steps JSONB)
summary.context: SQLite with better-sqlite3 stores JSON as TEXT. Understanding is a new column on plan_versions. Specification is stored within the existing steps JSONB column (no new column needed). Context column will be added as part of schema-context feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration adds 'understanding' TEXT column to plan_versions (default '{}')
Migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)
Existing plan_versions records receive understanding = '{}'
Storage layer parses understanding JSON on read
Storage layer stringifies understanding JSON on write
Storage layer validates understanding against Zod schema
Steps with specification field are correctly serialized/deserialized
Migration logs count of existing records updated

steps.title: Add understanding column migration
steps.description: Update src/storage/migration.ts to add understanding TEXT column to versions table

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration checks if column exists before adding (idempotent)
Column definition: understanding TEXT
Migration runs on app startup

steps.title: Migrate existing plan version data
steps.description: Set understanding to '{}' for all existing plan versions and log migration count

acceptance_criteria.description: UPDATE versions SET understanding = '{}' WHERE understanding IS NULL
Migration logs: 'Migrated N existing plan versions with empty understanding'
Idempotent: re-running does not affect already-migrated records

steps.title: Update storage interface
steps.description: Update src/storage/interface.ts to include understanding in PlanVersionRow type

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanVersionRow includes: understanding: string (JSON string)
Interface methods handle understanding field

steps.title: Update SQLite storage - write path
steps.description: Update src/storage/sqlite.ts to stringify understanding on write operations

acceptance_criteria.description: createPlanVersion() includes understanding in INSERT (default '{}')
updatePlanVersion() can update understanding field
Understanding is JSON.stringify'd before INSERT/UPDATE

steps.title: Update SQLite storage - read path
steps.description: Update src/storage/sqlite.ts to parse understanding JSON on read operations

acceptance_criteria.description: getPlanVersion() parses understanding JSON and validates against UnderstandingSchema
listPlanVersions() includes parsed understanding
Invalid JSON falls back to empty object {}

steps.title: Verify step specification serialization
steps.description: Ensure steps with specification field are correctly handled in existing steps JSONB serialization

acceptance_criteria.description: Steps with specification field serialize correctly to JSON
Steps with specification field deserialize and validate against StepSchema
Existing steps without specification continue to work

steps.title: Add storage tests for understanding
steps.description: Add tests to src/storage/sqlite.test.ts for understanding persistence and data migration

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: Create plan version with understanding, retrieve it, verify understanding matches
Test: Update plan version understanding, verify persistence
Test: Create plan version without understanding, verify defaults to {}
Test: Create step with specification, retrieve plan, verify specification in step
Test: Migration sets understanding='{}' for pre-existing versions with NULL understanding
